item.title: UpSnap
item.description: Wake-on-LAN web app, built on PocketBase. Scans the LAN for devices, then powers them on (WOL magic packets) or off (over ssh), from a UI or a cron schedule.

item.title: Clipse API
item.description: Tiny custom API to push clipboard entries to the homelab from anywhere (mainly from iOS shortcuts), and read the latest one back. Entries are written to clipse’s history file, which lives in a Syncthing-synced folder, so anything sent to the API ends up in the clipboard history of my machines.

item.title: Comments API
item.description: Custom solution that provides a comments section to every page of the Wiki. The frontend is generated by a script which is included at the bottom of every Quartz page.

item.title: Ollama
item.description: Runs LLMs locally, exposing them through a simple API (and to any compatible frontend). ollama.com Setup Stack config: github.com/one137/dockerhost-stacks/blob/main/stacks/50-ollama.yml CPU-only inference on the 7945HX, so the container is given generous limits (10G RAM, 22 CPUs) while staying otherwise locked down (read_only, cap_drop: ALL + SYS_NICE, no-new-privileges).
